How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Great question! Standard shipping in the US usually takes 5-7 business days, and for Canada (excluding Quebec), it's about 10-15 business days. Just a heads up, weather or other unexpected events can sometimes cause delays. DHL handles the shipping, and USPS will bring it to your door. If you have any other questions about shipping or our blends, just let me know! 🚚✨

What's your return and refund policy?

Happy to help with this! We stand by our blends and our customers—if something’s not vibing with you, we’ve got a 30-day guarantee. Just let us know within 30 days of receiving your order if you’re not satisfied, and we’ll work to make it right. No need to send anything back. If you have a specific issue or want to start a return, just give me a shout and we’ll get you sorted! ✨
